title: pouzolzia frondosa var. waitziana
intro: Pouzolzia frondosa var. waitziana, commonly known as Philippine cat's whiskers, is a plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional folk medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The plant has been reported to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antioxidant activities, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Pouzolzia frondosa var. waitziana include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
